read.en: TSMC rose 0.8% on Nov 18 to $362.62, trading $356.77–368.85. It is below the 5-day ($380.0), 10-day ($382.7), 30-day ($411.3) and 100-day ($423.1), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($403.5). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($415.53), and RSI is 36.8.
read.zh: 台积电 11月18日上涨 0.8%，收于 $362.62，盘中区间 $356.77–368.85。股价位于下行的 5 日（$380.0）、10 日（$382.7）、30 日（$411.3）和 100 日均线（$423.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$403.5）下方。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$415.53），RSI 为 36.8。

read.en: No level changed: the $368.85 high stalled in the $368–373 resistance, and the $356.77 low stayed above the Nov 5 low ($351.19). Resistance is $368–373 (Nov 6, 16 and Jul 29 lows, Nov 17 high), then $375.4–382.7 (Nov 6 close, 5-day, 10-day) and $385.5–388.6. Support is $351.2–356.8, then $338.6–341.8 (early April) and $326.8. A close above $373 would target $375–383; below $351.2, $340.
